mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to items of cost not ascribable to particular units of article carried in stock but incidental to such article."

The service mix is one of the key tools of non-price competition for setting one store apart from another.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ability to cause someone to do something he/she could not have done otherwise."

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an organisation independent of producer and retailer, which undertakes the classic functions of distribution (Cox 1978)."
The wholesaler is an organisation independent of producer and retailer, which undertakes the classic functions of distribution (Cox 1978).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the third major type of wholesaling intermediary."
Manufacturers' sales branches and offices are the third major type of wholesaling intermediary.
